originating_goal: Provide a non-authorizing discovery/routing plane over verified heartbeat-owned StegGate micro-nodes without making a persistent third-party host an activation prerequisite.

strongest_completed_tunnel_evidence.note: The recorded quick-tunnel origin is lease-bound and must be re-resolved/reverified for current use; historical PASS does not assert present liveness.

optional_stable_domain_hardening.note: A provider-specific stable-domain publication lane may be retained as availability/discovery hardening, but absence of its credentials must not block the canonical tunnel-native path.

machine_observable_release_condition: A current heartbeat-owned StegGate tunnel is published or otherwise discoverable and independently passes canonical health plus the full StegGate acceptance contract.
next_machine_action: Resolve the current heartbeat tunnel; if live, verify health/self-test/evaluate and record the current lease evidence. If no current tunnel is discoverable, use the canonical heartbeat worker path rather than waiting for Render or provider-specific stable-host credentials.
reason_archive_dependency_false: The architecture no longer depends on absent persistent-host credentials; the canonical tunnel path and its current-liveness release condition are durable and machine-observable.
